flow-definition.description: CD pipeline: deploys an immutable image tag/digest produced by CI into devops-app. Never rebuilds images.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: IMAGE_TAG
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Immutable image tag produced by the CI pipeline (git short SHA).

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: IMAGE_DIGEST
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Image digest(s) produced by the CI pipeline, for verification.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: NAMESPACE
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Target Kubernetes namespace to deploy into.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: TRIGGERED_BY_BUILD
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Upstream CI build identifier/URL, for traceability.

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: APP_COMMIT_SHA
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: Exact commit SHA (full 40-char) of AWS-DevOps-Kubernetes to deploy, produced by CI.
